intro A j; simp_rw [fun t=>(F t).val.property.1.point, he]
          let P u:= (observe T u).regularOccurrence W j A
          let α:=P A₀; let b:=P B₀
          refine ⟨fun i=>α+b*i,(FullVolume.Ray.ink.straight ..).rise (by norm_num),fun i=>?_⟩
          have hp (x:Home T): (observe T x|>.reg)=(layout G (S) W).reg:= rfl
          unfold α b P Activities.regularOccurrence; dsimp only; simp_rw [hp]
          by_cases hh: Healthy ((W).threshold) ((layout G (S) W).reg j|>.support) A
          · rw [masked_eq _ _ _ _ hh,masked_eq _ _ _ _ hh,masked_eq _ _ _ _ hh]; rw [mul_comm _ i.val]; rfl
          rw [masked_ne _ _ _ _ hh, masked_ne _ _ _ _ hh, masked_ne _ _ _ _ hh,zero_mul,zero_add]
        intro W' j; simp_rw [he]; let x := (observe T A₀).K j W'; let y:=(observe T B₀).K j W'
        exact ⟨_,(FullVolume.Ray.ink.straight x y).rise (by norm_num),fun t=> by rw [mul_comm y t.val]; rfl⟩)

proof_context.conclusion: `tours`: along the line the regular occurrence is `α+b*i` and the forced function is `x+y*t` (`ink.straight`), with the health test `Healthy` and the masks (`masked_eq`/`masked_ne`) independent of the parameter.

structure SectorOn (V:sun→ Chord.Flight A N m n)(Y:Mist A.B.a m (fire G (D.L (A.B.a.clock.J (m+1))) (A.B.a.clock.hatBeta m)) (thaw G (D.L (A.B.a.clock.J (m+1))) (A.B.a.clock.hatBeta m))) : Prop where
  pays (t:sun) : (V t|>.val.beta)=(Y.peak t).val
  layout i j:listIn (V i).val=listIn (V j).val
  lineE : ∀ x i,∃ (f:ℝ→ℝ), FullVolume.Ray.ink 2 f ∧∀ t:sun,f t=(V t).val.activities.regularOccurrence (V t).val.p i x
  lineK : ∀ x i,∃ (f:ℝ→ℝ), FullVolume.Ray.ink 2 f ∧∀ t:sun,f t=(V t).val.activities.K i x

proof_context.conclusion: `SectorOn`: the layout `listIn` (flags, allocation, tags, charts) is the same for every line parameter, and regular and forced outputs are polynomials of degree at most 2 (`ink 2`) in it.
